name: Inferno
rootCause: The Inferno token contract on Ethereum was exploited due to a lack of slippage protection on its swap or liquidity interaction functions. The attacker leveraged flash loans to manipulate the token's spot price in the associated liquidity pool within a single transaction, then executed swaps or token purchases through the unprotected contract function at the artificially skewed price, extracting approximately $440K. Without a minimum-output check or price-impact limit, the contract had no defence against intra-block price manipulation, allowing the attacker to profit from the price delta before the liquidity pool rebalanced. This attack follows a recurring pattern on Ethereum where token contracts that interact with AMM pools without enforcing slippage guards are vulnerable to flash-loan-driven price manipulation. Attack Tx: 0x7f78389cdc19c59c402fa9dddabcdbe7b9e6630f124362a764c0826ac863903c Analysis: Phalcon Alert
